title: Listening Practice Test 14 – Hotels & Hospitality
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9, có sơ đồ). Chủ đề: khách sạn, đặt phòng, tổ chức sự kiện.

groups.transcript:
(A) A guest is checking in at a front desk.
(B) Some luggage has been placed on a cart.
(C) A porter is pushing a cart through a lobby.
(D) A bell is being rung.

options.A: A guest is checking in at a front desk.
options.B: Some luggage has been placed on a cart.
options.C: A porter is pushing a cart through a lobby.

questions.explanation: Hành lý đã được đặt lên xe đẩy → (B). Sảnh không có người nên (A), (C) sai; 'is being rung' cần có người đang bấm chuông (D).

groups.transcript:
(A) A housekeeper is making a bed.
(B) Some curtains are being opened.
(C) Some towels have been folded on a bed.
(D) A clock has been placed on a bedside table.

options.A: A housekeeper is making a bed.
options.C: Some towels have been folded on a bed.
options.D: A clock has been placed on a bedside table.

questions.explanation: Chiếc đồng hồ báo thức nằm trên tủ đầu giường → (D). Không có người (A), (B); trên giường không có khăn (C).

groups.transcript:
Could I get a late checkout tomorrow?
(A) I checked it out from the library.
(B) Before eleven o'clock.
(C) Let me see what's available.

options.A: I checked it out from the library.

questions.explanation: Yêu cầu trả phòng muộn → 'Để tôi kiểm tra xem còn được không'. (A) 'check out' với nghĩa mượn sách; (B) chỉ là giờ, không trả lời yêu cầu.

groups.transcript:
Where's the hotel's fitness center?
(A) On the second floor, next to the pool.
(B) It fits perfectly.
(C) From six a.m. to ten p.m.

options.A: On the second floor, next to the pool.
options.C: From six a.m. to ten p.m.

questions.explanation: Where → vị trí. (B) bẫy âm 'fitness' – 'fits'; (C) trả lời câu hỏi giờ mở cửa.

groups.transcript:
Does the room rate include breakfast?
(A) At a very good rate.
(B) Yes, it's served from seven to ten.
(C) I'll include it in the report.

options.B: Yes, it's served from seven to ten.
options.C: I'll include it in the report.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → 'Có, phục vụ từ 7 đến 10 giờ'. (A) lặp 'rate'; (C) lặp 'include'.

groups.transcript:
How did you find the conference hotel?
(A) It was very comfortable.
(B) I found it on the desk.
(C) The conference ended early.

options.B: I found it on the desk.

questions.explanation: 'How did you find…?' ở đây hỏi cảm nhận (bạn thấy khách sạn thế nào) → 'Rất thoải mái'. (B) hiểu 'find' là tìm thấy – bẫy; (C) lặp 'conference'.

groups.transcript:
Would you like a room with a city view or an ocean view?
(A) Yes, it's a great view.
(B) The city is very large.
(C) The ocean, please.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → chọn hướng biển. (A) Yes không hợp và lặp 'view'; (B) lặp 'city'.

groups.transcript:
Isn't the restaurant closed for renovations?
(A) Close the window, please.
(B) It reopened last week.
(C) Near the lobby.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định xác nhận nhà hàng đóng cửa → 'Nó mở lại tuần trước rồi'. (A) bẫy 'closed' – 'close'; (C) trả lời Where.

groups.transcript:
W: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under the name Emma Clarke.
M: Welcome, Ms. Clarke. I'm afraid your room isn't ready yet. Check-in time is three o'clock, and it's only one thirty.
W: Oh. I have a business meeting at two, and I was hoping to change clothes first.
M: I understand. You're welcome to use the changing room at our fitness center on the second floor. And we can keep your suitcase here at the front desk.
W: That would be very helpful. Thank you.
M: I'll also have your luggage sent up to your room as soon as it's ready.

questions.content: Where does the man most likely work?
questions.explanation: 'Reservation', 'check-in time', 'front desk' → khách sạn.
'I have a business meeting at two, and I was hoping to change clothes first.'

questions.content: What does the man offer to do?
questions.explanation: 'We can keep your suitcase here at the front desk.'

groups.transcript:
W: Good morning, Ahmed and Luis. As you know, a group of sixty guests from the Global Pharma conference arrives this afternoon.
M1: Yes. I've prepared all the key cards and welcome packets.
M2: But the elevator on the east side is still out of order.
W: Right. The technician won't be here until tomorrow.
M1: Then we should give the conference guests rooms on the lower floors of the east wing, or rooms in the west wing.
W: Good idea. Luis, could you update the room assignments?
M2: Sure. I'll do it right away.

options.D: A new manager will start work.

questions.explanation: 'A group of sixty guests… arrives this afternoon.' (B) sai: kỹ thuật viên ngày mai mới tới.

questions.content: Why does one of the men say, “the elevator on the east side is still out of order”?

options.A: To explain why he was late
options.D: To point out a problem for arriving guests

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: đoàn 60 khách sắp tới mà thang máy phía đông còn hỏng → sẽ gây bất tiện cho khách. Cả nhóm sau đó điều chỉnh việc xếp phòng.

questions.content: What is Luis asked to do?
questions.explanation: 'Luis, could you update the room assignments?' (A) đã được người kia làm xong.

groups.transcript:
M: Hello, I'd like to book a room for this Friday and Saturday night.
W: Certainly. How many guests?
M: Just my wife and me. We'd like a room with a balcony. Do any of your rooms have one?
W: Our deluxe rooms and suites do. The deluxe room would be the most economical choice.
M: Great, I'll take that. Is parking included?
W: Parking is fifteen dollars a night, but it's free if you book through our Web site.

questions.content: What does the man want in a room?
questions.explanation: 'We'd like a room with a balcony.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. How much will the man most likely pay per night?
questions.explanation: Phòng Deluxe, đặt tối thứ Sáu và thứ Bảy → giá cột Fri.–Sat. là $190. (B) $160 là giá ngày thường – bẫy.

questions.content: How can the man get free parking?
questions.explanation: 'It's free if you book through our Web site.'

groups.transcript: Good evening, guests, and welcome to the Grand Palms Resort. Tonight at seven, we're hosting a welcome dinner on the beach terrace, featuring local seafood and live music. The dinner is free for all guests staying five nights or more. Also, please note that the main swimming pool will be closed tomorrow morning for cleaning. The rooftop pool will remain open. For tours of the island, please visit the activities desk next to the gift shop.

questions.content: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.explanation: 'Welcome to the Grand Palms Resort.'

questions.content: Who can attend the dinner for free?

options.B: Guests staying for a longer period

questions.explanation: 'The dinner is free for all guests staying five nights or more' → khách lưu trú dài ngày.

options.A: A tour will leave from the hotel.
options.B: The gift shop will open late.
options.C: A new menu will be introduced.
options.D: A swimming pool will be closed.

questions.explanation: 'The main swimming pool will be closed tomorrow morning for cleaning.'

groups.transcript: Hi, this is Steven Park from the Westbrook Hotel's event department. I'm calling about your company's awards dinner on June twelfth. You requested the Crystal Ballroom for one hundred and fifty guests. Unfortunately, the ballroom is being renovated, and the work won't be finished until the end of June. Our Garden Hall is available that evening. It holds two hundred. And I can offer you a fifteen percent discount on the food and beverage package. Please let me know by Friday if that works for you.

questions.content: What event is the speaker calling about?
questions.explanation: '…your company's awards dinner on June twelfth' → buổi trao giải.

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, “It holds two hundred”?

options.A: To indicate that a room is large enough

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: khách dự 150 người, Garden Hall chứa được 200 → đủ rộng để thay thế phòng khiêu vũ.

options.C: A reduced price on food and drinks

questions.explanation: 'I can offer you a fifteen percent discount on the food and beverage package.'

groups.transcript: Welcome to your first day at the Lakeview Hotel. Let's start with a quick tour of the ground floor. We're standing in the lobby now. Guests who arrive before check-in time often ask where they can leave their bags. Our luggage storage room is between the restaurant and the front desk. Later this morning, you'll shadow an experienced staff member at the front desk. And don't forget, employees get a thirty percent discount at the hotel restaurant.

questions.content: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.explanation: 'Welcome to your first day at the Lakeview Hotel', 'shadow an experienced staff member' → nhân viên mới.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Where can guests leave their luggage?
questions.explanation: Phòng giữ hành lý nằm giữa Restaurant và Front Desk – trên sơ đồ là Room G2.
'Employees get a thirty percent discount at the hotel restaurant.'
